column3: GNU df supports --output but rejects the Windows drive path under WSL (rc 1, empty stdout); the 1.x C++ applet prints a table (rc 0). Rust pilot documents the C++ drive-path model.
Operand C:\Windows is a Windows drive path: GNU under WSL sees no such file and exits 1; the 1.x C++ applet resolves the drive and prints a filesystem table (rc 0), which the Rust pilot follows.
